extras: Uses non-public Canvas internals; requires manual installation of files.
intentEvidence: Canvas Layer Order adds PowerPoint-style layer controls to Obsidian Canvas, making it easier to work with overlapping cards.
problem: Managing the visual stacking order of overlapping cards in Obsidian Canvas is difficult without manual manipulation of the underlying data structure.
summary: Adds PowerPoint-style layer controls to Obsidian Canvas, allowing users to bring cards to the front or back and manage overlapping card order.
